verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented control or policy that stops customer data from being used to train AI models. The closest feature is Zero Data Retention, an enterprise feature for deleting task data. That is a related retention control, not a training opt-out, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: Zero Data Retention is an enterprise feature that provides enhanced data privacy by allowing you to delete all data associated with completed tasks.
